source_policy.holiday_rule: If a U.S. cash-market or CME holiday occurs, keep the last completed official cash/settlement trade date and store any verified holiday-session indication separately; never relabel futures or foreign quotes as a U.S. cash close.
source_policy.uncertainty_rule: Keep null when an exact same-instrument final cannot be independently verified. Never blend observations from different trade dates, sessions or futures contracts.
source_policy.cross_source_rule: If same-date sources disagree, keep the highest-authority exact series and mark validation_required; do not silently choose a value from a different date or instrument.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Apple launches $1,999 foldable iPhone Duo with 2nm A20 Pro and pushes on-device AI
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters reports Apple's first major event under CEO John Ternus introduced the passport-shaped iPhone Duo with a 7.6-inch inner display, A20 Pro on a 2nm process, new C2 modem, and stronger on-device AI/privacy positioning. Siri AI is set to integrate with more than 300,000 apps.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: A direct test of premium-device demand, 2nm silicon adoption, memory content and whether Apple can improve its on-device AI differentiation; Apple shares still closed lower on the day.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Google commits €13 billion ($15.1 billion) to Finland AI infrastructure and nuclear power
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Google will build three northern-Finland data centers over two years and signed a 22-year nuclear-power agreement with Fortum; Alphabet lifted 2026 global investment to $195-$205 billion.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Confirms hyperscaler AI capex remains enormous and increasingly constrained by power, grid and data-center capacity rather than demand alone; positive read-through for advanced chips, networking, power and cooling.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: OpenAI expands AI into chip design and deepens next-generation chip work with Samsung
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: OpenAI said its models helped take its Jalapeno chip to tape-out within nine months and separately said it is working with Samsung on next-generation chips. OpenAI's previously disclosed Broadcom-designed first AI chip is expected to be manufactured by TSMC.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: AI is moving into EDA/chip-design workflows while frontier-model builders diversify silicon suppliers; the foundry and advanced-memory supply chain remains strategically important.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Tencent-backed Enflame prepares $912 million Shanghai AI-chip IPO
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Enflame raised 6.12 billion yuan and forecasts January-September revenue growth of 326%-455%, highlighting the rapid scaling of China's domestic accelerator ecosystem.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Adds to medium-term competitive and export-control risk for NVIDIA in China while confirming that accelerator spending remains broad globally.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Semiconductor leadership remains mixed rather than uniformly risk-off
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: AMD gained 2.81% while SOX rose about 0.35%; NVIDIA fell 0.77%, TSM ADR fell 0.82% and Microsoft fell 0.38%. No higher-confidence standalone NVIDIA or Microsoft announcement in the last 24 hours outweighed the macro/sector rotation.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: The tape continues to favor selective AI compute and semiconductor exposure even as $100 Brent and 10-year yields near 4.85% pressure the broader equity multiple.

breaking_news.headline: Brent closes above $100 and WTI at $96.05 as U.S.-Iran tanker attacks escalate
breaking_news.summary: Brent settled at $101.21 and WTI at $96.05 after the U.S. sank five Iranian tankers and Iran attacked 10 ships, intensifying threats to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz.
breaking_news.market_impact: Oil-to-inflation-to-yields is the dominant macro transmission channel into PPI/CPI; prolonged disruption raises the probability of tighter central-bank policy and compresses long-duration equity valuations.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Taiwan's high-duration technology complex remains sensitive to U.S. yields, while shipping/energy themes can receive relative support.

breaking_news.headline: Wall Street falls for a third session as oil and bond yields rise
breaking_news.summary: S&P 500 fell 0.48%, Nasdaq 0.64%, Dow 0.77% and Russell 2000 1.32%; VIX rose to 16.46. The 10-year Treasury yield finished around 4.841% after touching roughly 4.853%.
breaking_news.market_impact: The market is repricing inflation and rate risk rather than an AI-demand collapse; small caps underperformed while semiconductors remained relatively resilient.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. Treasury schedules up to $6 billion long-dated buyback after bond selloff
breaking_news.summary: The Treasury announced a September 10 operation to buy up to $6 billion of 10- to 20-year bonds, triple the size of its prior long-dated buyback, aimed at supporting liquidity rather than changing fiscal supply fundamentals.
breaking_news.market_impact: May reduce market-functioning stress at the margin, but it did not prevent 10-year yields from reaching their highest area since late 2023.

breaking_news.headline: Taiwan stocks edge higher while foreign futures shorts are trimmed
breaking_news.summary: TAIEX closed 47,183.36, up 77.58 points (+0.16%). September TX regular session closed 47,187 (+232), total OI fell to 98,469 and foreign net OI improved to -81,066; the latest 9/10-designated night session then closed 46,984 (-0.41%).
breaking_news.market_impact: Cash demand remains resilient and foreign futures hedging eased by 1,196 contracts, but the overnight reversal shows sensitivity to oil/yield risk.

narration_points: 今天第一主線不是AI需求崩壞，而是油價再次成為宏觀定價核心：Brent正式收101.21美元、WTI收96.05美元，美伊互擊油輪讓能源通膨風險再升級。
美股連三天下跌：S&P 500收7636.36、跌0.48%；Nasdaq跌0.64%、Dow跌0.77%、Russell 2000跌1.32%，VIX升到16.46。
10年期美債收在約4.841%，盤中觸及約4.853%，已逼近52週高點；DXY約98.83，黃金12月期貨則結算4458.80美元，顯示地緣避險與升息壓力同時存在。
半導體相對抗跌：SOX約升0.35%，AMD再漲2.81%；但NVIDIA跌0.77%、TSM ADR跌0.82%，顯示AI鏈仍是選股輪動而非全面上漲。
AI基本面仍強。Google宣布未來兩年在芬蘭投入約151億美元AI基礎設施並簽22年核電合約，說明瓶頸正在從GPU延伸到電力、資料中心、網路與散熱。
Apple推出1999美元首款折疊iPhone Duo，搭載2奈米A20 Pro並強調裝置端AI；同時OpenAI表示AI已能加速晶片設計並深化與Samsung合作，TSMC仍是OpenAI首款Broadcom合作AI晶片的重要代工鏈。
最新9月10日歸屬夜盤正式收46984、跌194點或0.41%，成交31951口；TAIFEX夜盤OI欄仍為『-』，所以night_session_oi維持null，不能拿日盤98469口冒充。
財報先看AeroVironment優於預期與15億美元backlog，今晚真正關鍵是Oracle與Adobe；前者驗證AI Cloud與資料中心資本支出，後者驗證生成式AI軟體變現。
最後是今晚PPI與明晚CPI。若油價衝擊已開始傳到核心通膨，10年債可能再創高並壓縮AI估值；若通膨沒有同步失控，半導體相對強勢仍有延續空間。
